title: Story premise EDU076: The Two Seasonal Clocks
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: What if dinner’s clock moves faster than the guest’s? Takeaway/theme: Interacting species can depend on overlapping seasonal events.
description: A migrating visitor wants to arrive when a food resource is available, but two seasonal timing bands shift differently in the model. Aligning the bands reveals a possible mismatch without claiming it happens for every species.
